jobs.title: AVP, Technology and Transformation Risk
jobs.description:
Experience Aviva

Individually we are people, but together we are Aviva. Individually these are just words, but together they are our Values – Care, Commitment, Community, and Confidence.

At Aviva Canada, we put people first, our employees, our customers, and our communities. We’re proud of a culture built on care, inclusion, and collaboration, where your voice matters and your growth is supported. We’re not just about insurance; we’re about making a real difference by protecting what matters most.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an AVP, Technology & Transformation Risk to lead second‑line oversight of technology, data privacy, data governance, cybersecurity and transformation across Aviva Canada. In this role, you’ll shape how we manage data risk, strengthen controls, and respond to an evolving regulatory and technology landscape.

You’ll work closely with partners across the business to provide independent challenge, guide decision‑making, and support strong governance practices. You will also play a key role in advancing our approach to emerging areas such as GenAI, automation, and data ethics.

This is a highly visible opportunity to influence strategy, build positive relationships, and help ensure Aviva delivers safe, fair, and trusted outcomes for our customers.

What You’ll Do

Provide second‑line oversight of technology, cyber security practices, data privacy, data governance and transformation risks.
Partner with first‑line teams to identify risks, strengthen controls, and improve data practices.
Lead data risk reviews, deep dives, and assessment activities to ensure regulatory and policy alignment.
Deliver clear, insight‑driven reports that highlight trends, issues, and emerging risks.
Build positive relationships across the business to support consistent and effective risk management.
Champion best practices in cybersecurity, data governance, privacy, GenAI, and automation.
Collaborate with teams to enable safe and efficient automation and AI use cases.
Maintain documentation that supports governance, transparency, and compliance.
Contribute to strong customer outcomes through sound risk oversight.

What You’ll Bring

A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Business, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in data governance, data management, analytics, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of Cyber Security including ISO 27001 and NIST framework
Strong understanding of data privacy, data quality, and regulatory expectations.
Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to influence partners at all levels.
Experience assessing risks, reviewing controls, and preparing insight‑driven reports.
Ability to tackle sophisticated problems, make sound decisions, and drive outcomes.
Strong relationship‑building skills and a collaborative working style.
Knowledge of data architecture, data lineage, data quality, data retention and emerging data practices.
Good understanding of Secure by Design principles
Curiosity and adaptability to keep pace with evolving technologies, including AI and automation.

What Makes You Stand Out

Experience working with GenAI, automation, and AI governance.
Familiarity with operational risk practices.
Strong visual communication and storytelling skills.
Ability to effectively challenge senior leaders with confidence and clarity.
Deep understanding of cyber, data, and IT infrastructure domains.

What You’ll Get

Compelling rewards package including base compensation, eligibility for annual bonus, retirement savings, share plan, health benefits, personal wellness, and volunteer opportunities.
Hybrid flexible work model.
Outstanding career development opportunities.
We’ll support your professional development education.
Competitive vacation package with the option to purchase 5 extra days off per year.
Employee-driven programs focused on gender, LGBTQ+, origins, diversity, and inclusion.
Corporate wellness programs to support our employees’ physical and mental health.

This job advertisement is for an existing vacancy which has been posted both internally & externally.

Aviva Canada may use AI (Artificial Intelligence) tools to assist us throughout the recruitment process to screen, assess or select applicants for a position.

Aviva Canada welcomes applications from all qualified individuals and has a process in place to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities at all stages of the hiring process and during employment. If you require an accommodation during the interview or hiring process, please contact your Aviva Talent Acquisition Partner so that an appropriate accommodation can be arranged.

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Management, Platform & Innovation
jobs.description:
At Appfire, we believe that great work happens when people get to choose how they work. After 20 years of creating software that empowers teams to break silos and collaborate seamlessly, we've learned that one size does not fit all. We're a team of 800+ employees, working remotely across 28 countries. Our flagship products include: JXL, Comala Document Management, 7Pace Time Tracker, Jira Misc Workflow Extensions, and BigPicture.

Here you can read some of our customer stories: https://appfire.com/resources/resource-library/customer-stories

Appfire is seeking a Vice President, Product Management, Platform & Innovation
to lead three connected areas central to the company's next phase of growth: the Appfire Platform, the Innovation portfolio, and Appfire's technical product relationship with Atlassian.

You will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Appfire Platform
, the shared services and AI capabilities that power our products, accelerate delivery, and create leverage across the portfolio. You will also lead the Innovation team
, responsible for discovering, validating, incubating, and launching the next generation of Appfire products.

As Appfire's senior product leader for the technical dimension of our Atlassian relationship, you will anticipate platform, API, Forge, and Marketplace changes; represent Appfire in technical and roadmap discussions; and translate ecosystem shifts into competitive advantage, product opportunity, and managed risk.

As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will help shape strategy across the broader portfolio, translate company priorities into focused product bets, and build a high-performing team of product leaders. You will partner closely with Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive leadership.

Success will be measured by the adoption and business impact of platform capabilities, the quality and velocity of the innovation pipeline, and the revenue and strategic value created by new products launched through your team.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

Partner with executive leadership to establish a compelling vision for the Appfire Platform and new-product portfolio as part of the broader company strategy.
Translate that vision into a clear investment thesis, product roadmap, measurable objectives, and operating plan.
Make disciplined decisions about where to build, buy, partner, invest, scale, or stop.
Maintain a clear view of progress, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, adjusting priorities as market and business conditions change.
Communicate strategy, decisions, and outcomes clearly across executive, technical, and business audiences.

Platform Product Leadership

Treat the Appfire Platform as a product, with defined customers, value propositions, roadmaps, adoption goals, and success measures.
Define and deliver shared platform capabilities, including AI-enabled services, that increase customer value, enable revenue growth, accelerate product delivery, and reduce duplicated effort.
Drive adoption across Appfire by reducing integration friction, establishing effective rollout and migration plans, and partnering closely with product and engineering teams.
Establish metrics for platform adoption, reliability, cost efficiency, developer experience, time to market, and business impact.
Build strong feedback loops with internal product teams and other platform users to ensure the roadmap addresses their highest-value needs.
Communicate and demonstrate the value of the platform throughout the organization.

Innovation and New Growth

Lead the Innovation team in identifying, validating, incubating, and launching net-new product opportunities.
Build and actively manage a portfolio of product bets aligned with customer needs, market opportunity, and Appfire's strategic advantages.
Apply a disciplined 0-to-1 approach to customer discovery, market validation, experimentation, business-case development, and commercial launch.
Establish clear stage gates and evidence-based criteria for advancing, changing, scaling, or stopping investments.
Partner with Go-to-Market leaders on positioning, pricing, packaging, launch, and early commercial traction.
Own the path from initial concept to measurable customer adoption and revenue.
Transition validated products into the appropriate scaling organization when they are ready to move beyond incubation.

Atlassian Technical Relationship

Serve as Appfire's senior product owner for the technical dimension of the Atlassian relationship.
Represent Appfire in technical, platform, and roadmap discussions with Atlassian.
Maintain a forward-looking view of changes to Atlassian's platform, APIs, Forge architecture, Marketplace, security requirements, and developer ecosystem.
Translate ecosystem changes into product opportunities, competitive differentiation, internal readiness plans, and risk mitigation.
Influence Atlassian's technical direction where possible by clearly representing Appfire's needs, customer use cases, and strategic priorities.
Ensure relevant Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and business teams understand upcoming changes and are prepared to respond.

People and Organizational Leadership

Lead, develop, and grow a team of product managers and product leaders responsible for the Appfire Platform and Innovation portfolio.
Set clear expectations for product strategy, customer insight, commercial thinking, execution quality, and accountability.
Recruit and retain strong product talent while building a durable leadership bench and succession pipeline.
Coach team members to take on broader and more complex product leadership responsibilities.
Establish an effective operating cadence for planning, decision-making, performance management, and cross-functional alignment.
Communicate progress, outcomes, risks, and decisions effectively at every level of the organization.

About You

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA is preferred.
10+ years of progressively responsible product management experience, including 5+ years leading teams of product managers or product leaders.
Demonstrated success defining and scaling cloud platforms, shared services, APIs, or developer-facing capabilities in a SaaS, XaaS, or consumption-based business.
Proven experience taking net-new, 0-to-1 products from discovery through launch, customer adoption, and commercial traction.
Strong technical fluency across APIs, authentication and authorization, cloud architecture, high availability, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience translating platform investments into measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, faster time to market, increased adoption, improved productivity, lower operating cost, or greater reliability.
Commercial ownership of a significant software portfolio, including P&L, revenue, or equivalent business accountability.
Experience owning or contributing to a strategic technology-platform or partner relationship.
Strong executive judgment and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment through ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex tradeoffs.
A track record of building, coaching, and retaining high-performing product teams.

Preferred Experience

Experience building within the Atlassian ecosystem, including Forge, Marketplace, and Atlassian APIs.
Experience operating cloud services at significant scale, ideally exceeding 100 million daily service calls.
Commercial ownership of a XaaS portfolio exceeding $50 million in annual recurring revenue.
Experience building AI-enabled platform capabilities or commercial AI products.

What do we offer:

Work in a product-first SaaS B2B environment focused on building and scaling solutions for large enterprise customers
Deliver meaningful, high-impact work that directly influences product direction and customer success
Every Appfire team member is eligible for company equity, fostering a true sense of ownership and connection to our growth.
Employees receive 25 days of paid time off per year. After 5 years of employment, employees receive 30 days per year.
Appfire provides comprehensive coverage through Empire Health, including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Additional protection includes life insurance, critical illness coverage, accidental death and dismemberment, and long-term disability insurance.
To promote health and well-being, Appfire offers a yearly sport allowance of CAD 600, which can be used to cover the cost of various fitness or outdoor activities from gym memberships to sports equipment.
Volunteering - Every employee receives 3 fully paid days each year to participate in Appfire Town, our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program supporting local communities.

Market recognition

Appfire has been consistently recognized for company growth, culture, corporate social responsibility, and product excellence and has been included among the Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Inc. Best Workplaces, BuiltIn Best Places to Work, and Inc. 5000. Learn more about our accomplishments, which would not be possible without our team members, partners, and customers: https://appfire.com/awards.

Equal Employer Opportunity (EEO)

Appfire is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as defined by applicable law. Our commitment extends to all employment practices, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.

jobs.title: Director of Finance And Accounting
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic finance leader to oversee and lead the organization’s full finance function. Reporting to ownership, this role provides strategic financial leadership while maintaining accountability for the day-to-day execution of accounting operations.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted partner to leadership, helping guide financial strategy, support operational decision-making, strengthen financial performance, and prepare the organization for continued growth. At the same time, this individual must be comfortable remaining actively involved in the details of the finance function, including financial reporting, controls, payroll and team leadership.

The organization operates within a complex, project-driven environment where accurate job costing, project and division profitability analysis, inventory management, cash flow planning, and operational reporting are critical to success. Experience within construction, manufacturing, contracting, field services, or similarly complex operational industries will be highly valued.

This is a unique opportunity to join a growing, multi-entity organization at an exciting point in its evolution. Significant investments in systems, reporting capabilities, process improvement, and business growth are planned over the coming years, and this role will play a central leadership role in guiding that transformation.

Key Responsibilities

· Director of Finance & Business Leadership: Lead the organization’s overall finance strategy and financial operations. Partner with leadership to support growth, profitability, capital allocation, and strategic decision-making. Lead budgeting, forecasting, cash flow planning, performance reporting, and business analysis while translating financial information into actionable operational and strategic insight.

· Financial Stewardship & Controller Responsibilities: Oversee and maintain overall responsibility for the day-to-day accounting function, including financial reporting, month-end close, reconciliations, payroll, job costing, work-in-progress tracking, and internal controls. Ensure accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial information across multiple entities and business units.

· Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team. Establish clear expectations, build accountability, strengthen capabilities, and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

· Systems & Organizational Transformation: Lead major finance systems, reporting, automation, and process improvement initiatives. Champion modernization of the finance function through technology, data, and scalable business processes that support future growth.

· Compliance & Governance: Maintain strong accounting policies, internal controls, compliance processes, and audit readiness while supporting increasingly sophisticated operational and financial requirements.

What We're Looking For
· CPA designation preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
· 8–10+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including leadership responsibility.
· Strong Controller-level technical accounting capabilities combined with strategic business acumen.
· Construction, contracting, field service, or other project-based industry experience strongly preferred.
· Experience with job costing, profitability analysis, work-in-progress reporting, inventory management, and operational performance metrics is considered a significant asset.
· Experience operating within a multi-entity or operationally complex environment.
· Experience leading financial systems implementations, ERP projects, reporting enhancements, or organizational transformation initiatives.
· Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
· A hands-on leader who enjoys both strategic leadership and operational execution.

Why Join Us
This is more than a traditional finance role. The successful candidate will join an organization entering a period of significant growth and transformation, with opportunities to transform systems, improve reporting capabilities, modernize processes, and help scale the business for the future. This role offers a rare combination of strategic leadership and operational impact and will work closely with ownership and operational teams to drive performance for the next stage of growth.

As the senior finance leader, you will have the opportunity to shape the future direction of the finance function, lead meaningful change initiatives, develop a strong team, and influence key business decisions. For individuals who enjoy building, improving, and growing alongside a business, this role offers both immediate impact and significant long-term opportunity.

At the same time, we value leaders who remain connected to the work. This role requires someone who can think strategically, lead confidently, and roll up their sleeves when needed to ensure the finance function operates effectively each day.
